title: Alterative
summary: AL'TERATIVE, adjective Causing alteration; having the power to alter. AL'TERATIVE, noun A medicine which, without sensible operation, gradually induces a change in the habit or constitution and restor

inlines.v: AL'TERATIVE, adjective Causing alteration; having the power to alter. AL'TERATIVE, noun A medicine which, without sensible operation, gradually induces a change in the habit or constitution and restores healthy functions. This word is more generally used than alterant.
